body:
## HardcoreSoulShrines

![gif](https://i.imgur.com/OhtqSJN.gif)

**HardcoreSoulShrines** brings permanent death back into Hardcore Minecraft by letting alive players revive fallen friends at magical shrines using diamonds or another materials.

### About

**HardcoreSoulShrines** is a plugin designed for **Hardcore** servers where death is meant to be meaningful but not necessarily final.   

Admins can easily place shrines anywhere on the map, while players use them to bring back their fallen friends. The plugin keeps the hardcore spirit alive with increasing revival costs based on death count and full control over what happens after revival.

Perfect for **Hardcore SMPs**, roleplay servers, and any community that wants high-stakes gameplay with a fair chance at redemption.

### Features

- Admins can create shrines using **/shrine create [name]** (placed on a configurable block type such as beacon)
- Right-clicking a shrine opens a GUI showing all currently dead hardcore players
- Each soul entry displays the player’s name, total death count, and current revival cost
- Revival cost automatically increases with each death
- Living players can pay the cost in **diamons** or any configured materials to instantly revive the chosen player
- Revived players respawn at the shrine location with optional item restoration.
- Completely dead players are saved in the graveyard tab as a memory.

### Commands

```yaml
commands:
  shrine:
    description: Main command for HardcoreSoulShrines.
    usage: /shrine <create [name...]|remove|list|check|force-revive|reload>
    permission: hardcoresoulshrines.admin
  shrinereload:
    description: Reload HardcoreSoulShrines configuration.
    usage: /shrinereload
    permission: hardcoresoulshrines.admin
```

### Permissions

```yaml
permissions:
  hardcoresoulshrines.admin:
    description: Allows managing shrines and reloading the plugin.
    default: op
```
